_readme: Hand corrections keyed by the entry's source URL. Each value may have: add (tags to add), remove (tags to remove), primaryCategory (replaces the badge category). Valid tags: Full Robot, Drivetrain (Mecanum), Drivetrain (Tank), Drivetrain (Unspecified), Swerve Drive, Intake, Claw / Gripper, Linear Slides / Extension, Turret, Shooter, Differential / PTO, Vector Wheel, Number Plate / Misc, Misc, Other. After editing, run: npm run build-data
